Original UniProt sequence responses and requests for Q60352/MJ0044, close archaeal and other isopentenyl-phosphate-kinase leads, FomA relatives and independent ribosomal markers. The original gene_exact:ipk query also returns IspE aliases; the refined protein-name query supplies closer archaeal leads. Broad GHMP leads are preserved as excluded sampling inputs; the native tree uses IPK/FomA amino-acid-kinase-family leads, following the primary studies (PMC1447442 and PMID 19928876). Annotation names are comparison leads, not experimental facts or an expected answer supplied to the scientific model.

`native-pbs-9040517.json` preserves the actual native result/binding Source body
from PBS job `9040517.aurora-pbs-0001.hostmgmt.cm.aurora.alcf.anl.gov`, collected
on 2026-11-04 from compute host `x4217c5s3b0n0`. Its SHA-256 is
`aa3595ac4a8c850842443c1e4144287f93b8c61bb5983a47cc28175ab2844962`.
All four analyses have 1,000 usable bootstrap trees. This required input checks
physical branch correspondence, including LG split 9 versus MFP split 8.
The fixture is data for pure tests; it supplies no private runtime, publication
or scoring grant and cannot establish native-execution custody by itself.
